claim: Different agentic architectures (e.g., triage-ranking, single agent) perform differently across chemical domains, with triage-ranking excelling for Cu(100) targets while other designs perform comparably or better for M–N–C catalysts.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by comparing the performance of different agentic architectures on new materials discovery tasks across multiple domains.

conditions: CO adsorption on Cu(100) surface adatoms
CO adsorption on M–N–C single-atom catalysts
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific architectures compared and the two chemical domains; transfer to other architectures or domains is unestablished.

title: Agentic architecture type–Performance in identifying target principle
